falt.contentDescription: This advertisement, run by the Facebook page "MatSokker" (page ID 1338643506004296), reproduces our copyrighted advertising material without authorisation. The ad's video is cut from our own ad film "09-24 Katarina Sushigalen unge" (published by us on 24 September 2026, before this ad started running on 30 September 2026): 3 still frames from different scenes of the reported video (at 0:09, 0:11, 0:22) are identical to frames of our film (perceptual-hash distance 3, 2, 1/64). Our original ad is public in Meta's Ad Library: "09-24 Katarina Sushigalen unge" https://www.facebook.com/ads/library/?id=1660194462177066. It copies our ad "09-24 Katarina Sushigalen unge" for the product "Sushi-Strumpor", which our page ran before this ad appeared. This is report 2 of 9 concerning ads from the same advertiser; each ad is reported separately.
